people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.
translations.bsb: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
translations.kjv: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.
translations.asv: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, Jehovah, becamest their God.
